note: Triennial election of the Castlederg rural district councillors, 1939. Nominations closed on 18 April 1939. One candidate was nominated in each of fifteen divisions and returned unopposed; 'All retiring representatives were returned except Messrs. John James Young and John M'Askie, who replace Mr. James Leitch, J.P., and Capt. D. B. Williams, J.P.' For Clunahill no nomination was received and the retiring member, Mr. Michael M'Crea, was deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed. No poll was held; the folder date is the provisional Tyrone polling day. Returned unopposed.
